source_refs.note: 'Responsible Communication of Findings' under topic 7.6, as printed (PDF 102, printed 98).

blocks.text: Responsible communication of findings is essential in data science. Results should be presented honestly without exaggeration or manipulation. Limitations of the data and analysis must be clearly stated. Misleading visuals or selective reporting should be avoided. Clear explanations help stakeholders understand the results accurately. Ethical communication prevents misinterpretation and misuse of findings. Thus, truthful reporting strengthens credibility and trust in data analysis.
